COMCAST CORP (CMCSA) reported financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025, with the announcement released on January 29, 2026 S001. Consolidated revenue for the fourth quarter increased 1.2% year-over-year to $32.3 billion, while full-year revenue was flat at $123.7 billion S003, S014. Net income attributable to COMCAST CORP declined 54.6% to $2.2 billion in the quarter and $20.0 billion for the full year S003. Adjusted net income decreased 17.1% to $3.1 billion in Q4 and fell 5.7% to $16.0 billion for the full year S003, S069. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) were $0.84 in the quarter, down 12.4%, and $4.31 for the year, a 0.6% decline S003, S069.

Adjusted EBITDA was $7.9 billion in the quarter, down 10.3%, and $37.4 billion for the full year, a 1.8% decrease S003, S065. Free cash flow rose 34.0% to $4.4 billion in the quarter and 53.4% to $19.2 billion for the year S003, S066. Net cash provided by operating activities was $8.8 billion in the quarter and $33.6 billion for the year S003, S062. Capital expenditures decreased 4.2% to $3.7 billion in the quarter S016.

At Connectivity & Platforms, revenue declined 1.1% to $20.2 billion in the quarter S019, driven by a 2.1% decrease in Residential Connectivity & Platforms revenue, partially offset by a 5.8% increase in Business Services Connectivity revenue S019, S030. Residential revenue was impacted by declines in video, advertising, broadband, and other segments, partially offset by growth in domestic wireless and international connectivity S026. Domestic wireless added 364,000 lines in the quarter, reaching 9.3 million total lines S022, S007. Total customer relationships in Connectivity & Platforms decreased by 181,000 to 50.8 million S023.

Content & Experiences revenue increased 5.4% to $12.7 billion in the quarter, led by a 21.9% rise in Theme Parks revenue due to the opening of Epic Universe in May 2025 S032, S041. Peacock reached 44 million paid subscribers, up 22% year-over-year, with revenue growing 23% to $1.6 billion in the quarter S010. The company completed the tax-free separation of Versant Media Group on January 2, 2026 S013. Shareholder returns totaled $2.7 billion in the quarter via $1.2 billion in dividends and $1.5 billion in share repurchases S005.
